title: Major Glow Nourishing Bronzing Body Oil

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Body Lotions & Body Oils > Body Moisturizers > Bath & Body

descriptionHtml:
✓ Best for Dry, Combo, Normal Skin✓ Warm & Spicy Scent✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Floral Scent✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: A universal bronzing body oil for a healthy golden glow made with moisturizing acai oil, cupuassu butter, and a super-antioxidant blend.

Skincare Concerns: Dryness and Dullness

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Acai Oil and Cupuassu Butter: For moisture, shine, and enhanced skin elasticity.
- Plant-Derived Super-Antioxidant Blend: With rosemary, rice bran, sunflower, and tocopherol to protect the skin.

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance.
How to Use+

Suggested Usage:
-Use daily.

-Shake well.

-Massage into dry, exposed skin for instant glow.

Ingredients+
-Acai Oil and Cupuassu Butter: For moisture, shine, and enhanced skin elasticity.
-Plant-Derived Super-Antioxidant Blend: With rosemary, rice bran, sunflower, and tocopherol to protect the skin.

Mineral Oil (Paraffinum Liquidum/ Huile minérale), Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Silica Dimethyl Silylate, Fragrance (Parfum), Ethylene/Propylene/Styrene Copolymer, Trimethylsiloxysilicate, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Mica, Trihydroxystearin, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Extract, Bisabolol, Ethylhexyl Olivate, Calcium Sodium Borosilicate, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Extract, Theobroma Grandiflorum Seed Butter, Euterpe Oleracea Fruit Oil, Tocopherol, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Extract, Butylene/Ethylene/Styrene Copolymer, Squalane, Tin Oxide, BHT, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Benzyl Salicylate, Citral, Coumarin, Limonene, Linalool, Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77499), Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891).
